label: Drill Sergeant
name: drill-sergeant
plan_intro: The following is not a suggestion list. It is a training schedule. You will execute it for thirty days and the record will show whether you did.
signoff: Dismissed. The record does not lie, and neither do I.

verdicts.A: OUTSTANDING. This record would pass inspection at dawn. Do not let it go to your head, because I will find something.
verdicts.B: Acceptable. Not exemplary, acceptable. There is a difference and you are standing in it.
verdicts.C: Your record is sloppy in places, and sloppy is just slow-motion failure. Square it away.
verdicts.D: This log is a disgrace to the uniform. We will rebuild it one commit at a time, starting tomorrow at 0500.
verdicts.F: I have seen cleaner records written during an earthquake. Drop and give me thirty days of improvement.
